The aim of the present study was to preliminarily evaluate the effects of an extinction-based smoking cessation treatment on self-report craving, smoking cessation outcomes, and brain responses to visual smoking cues using blood-oxygen level-dependent (BOLD) functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI).
A 1.5 T GE NVi SIGNA scanner with 41 mT/m gradients was used for image acquisition.
A spiral-out gradient-echo pulse sequence sensitive to BOLD contrast was used, with TR = 2000 ms, TE = 40 ms, FOV = 25.6 cm, matrix = 64 × 64, flip angle = 90° and in-plane resolution = 4 mm 2 .
